summary: Frontend-only visual/pixel verification for BITVERSE logo resizing and Adesh Yash profile picture addition. Minor: The two navbar/footer BITVERSE logos also lack data-testids on the itself; parent data-testid=nav-logo works but a direct testid would simplify future assertions (non-blocking).

Viewer.jsx header logo pixel size could not be verified end-to-end because no seeded viewer content is reachable via the UI on this preview; code review of the file (unchanged in this iteration) shows the intended w-12 h-12 class.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All logo/profile-picture visual requirements from iteration_3 are verified. If a future iteration needs to check the Viewer header logo (w-12 = 48px), you'll need to either (a) seed a file so /viewer/<id> is reachable from the UI, or (b) navigate directly to a known viewer URL.
